_note: Encounter cards. Names and texts for Scroll, Couple beers, Order in and zone out, Name it, Phone in the kitchen, The floor version and What am I waiting for? are the Scene Book's. The rest follow the outline's card list; their wording is Claude's draft, waiting on Jim.

cards.name: Scroll
cards.text: Big relief now. Costs sleep. The phone gains pull.

cards.name: Couple beers
cards.text: Big relief now. Costs tomorrow morning, and two cans by the sink become four.

cards.name: Order in and zone out
cards.text: Some relief now. The cost is slow, and you won't see it tonight.

cards.name: Tomorrow.
cards.text: Put it off, with no new reason.

cards.name: Name it
cards.says: This isn't rest. This is hiding.

cards.name: Phone in the kitchen
cards.says: The phone sleeps in the kitchen.
cards.text: Takes Scroll out of your hand tonight.
cards.source: Offered on the first night at home. Yours after Morning Line.

cards.name: Remove the access
cards.says: There's no beer in this house.
cards.text: Takes Couple beers out of your hand at home.

cards.name: The floor version
cards.text: Ten minutes of the thing you've been putting off.
cards.source: Always in hand. The Daily Minimum makes it yours.

cards.name: What am I waiting for?
cards.text: Makes the old voice give its reason. If it has none, Resolve goes up.

cards.name: Show the record
cards.text: Answers "Nothing's changed." The record is proof.
cards.source: Earned after any three days of structure.

cards.name: Text Dana first
cards.says: You text Dana: rough night. Talk me out of the couch?
cards.source: Earned when Dana's trust is high enough.

cards.name: It's a plan change
cards.text: For when a real new fact changes the plan. Using it without one shows up later.
cards.source: Earned at the start of Ordinary Days.

tag.item: a changed plan and a miss are separate paths

cards.name: Remember why
cards.text: Resolve goes up. Grows with your Purpose line.

cards.name: Go to Dana
cards.text: Her car died at the gas station on [Main]. A real new fact.
